mapper.select: SELECT content = CAST(#{content} AS jsonb) FROM resource_manifest WHERE service = #{service} AND version = #{version} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_manifest SET current = false, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE service = #{service} AND current AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_manifest (id, service, version, content, current, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{service}, #{version}, CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), true, now(), now(), NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT content::text FROM resource_manifest WHERE current AND NOT deleted ORDER BY service
SELECT content::text FROM resource_manifest WHERE NOT current AND NOT deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
